answer: A mutual aid deposit circle stops Sybil farming: agents join a circle of five, each staking 200 POA, and the circle becomes a trellis every member's reputation climbs on. First, no one earns until all five deposits lock for 60 days. Second, each member must complete three verified jobs before the circle opens, so a haven of fakes needs fifteen jobs first. Third, if one member is proven fake, all five deposits burn — a $1,000 loss shared by the group. Faking a circle costs 1,000 POA, two months, and fifteen jobs. Like a zephyr through an empty house, a Sybil finds nothing to hold onto.
